columns.name: AGENT_ID
columns.description: The Unique Identifier of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: AGENT_CODE
columns.description: Stores the Agent Code of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: FAMILY
columns.description: Product family of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: PRODUCT
columns.description: Product area of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: AGENT_CREATED_DATE
columns.description: Created Date of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: OWNER_ID
columns.description: ID of the owner who created the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: OWNER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the owner who created the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: PROMPT_CODE
columns.description: Prompt Code of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow. FK to the prompt table

columns.name: NAMESPACE
columns.description: Namespace of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: VERSION
columns.description: Version of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: SPECIFICATION
columns.description: JSON specification of the Gen AI Agent in the Agentic Workflow

columns.name: MAX_INTERACTIONS
columns.description: Maximum number of interactions with LLM engine.

columns.name: AGENT_TYPE
columns.description: This column stores the Agent type.

columns.name: PROMPT
columns.description: Alternate prompt used by this agent.

columns.name: MODEL_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Reference to a LLM model configuration. Foreign key to FAI_MODEL_CONFIGS table.

columns.name: INTERNAL_NAME
columns.description: This column represents the system name of the Agent.

columns.name: INTERNAL_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This column represents the system description of the Agent.

columns.name: REUSABLE_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates whether the Agent is resusable.

columns.name: SEEDED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N. This column differentiates seeded data from customer created.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
